ExplanationOut.description:

was checked against the case.

JobOut.description: Work handed to a worker. ``run`` and ``cases`` are set once it has succeeded.
JobOut.title: JobOut

PeriodSummary.description:
``invoices``, ``payments`` and ``matched_invoices`` count the left file, the right file
and the left records that reconciled, whatever the type; ``labels`` says what they are.
PeriodSummary.title: PeriodSummary

RecordOut.description:
``role`` is the side of the match whatever the type (``invoice`` is the one record,
``payment`` one of the several that settle it); ``label`` is what to call it: Invoice,
Payment, Deposit or Payout.
RecordOut.title: RecordOut

SuggestionOut.description:
Which invoice an ambiguous payment was probably meant for. Advice for a person, never a
match: nothing is changed by it.
SuggestionOut.title: SuggestionOut

TypeLabels.description: How to talk about the two sides of a type of reconciliation.
TypeLabels.title: TypeLabels

UploadOut.description:
``reconciled`` is true when the run was done inside the request. With a job queue the
request returns ``job`` instead, with status 202, and ``run`` and ``cases`` come later.
UploadOut.title: UploadOut

post.description:
Ask a language model to explain the case.

Advice only: nothing about the case changes. The text is returned only if every record it
cites, every figure it states and every id in it checks out against the case; otherwise the
reasons are returned and the rule-written reading stands. A checked answer is kept, and
asking again for the same input returns it.
